note: Winner of the 2025 AMT Challenge (F1 0.5998, 0.006 above the runner-up). Music Information Retrieval Osnabrück; extends the YourMT3+ framework with a MusicFM encoder, a recurrent adapter over learned instrument-group embeddings, and parallel T5 decoders with RoPE + FlashAttention. Searched Hugging Face for a checkpoint: nothing published. Re-check if weights appear — it is the one system that beat the checkpoint we can run.

Code MIT, but weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 on all three sizes (HF org MuScriptor, small/medium/large) — non-commercial, so unusable here. The arXiv HTML states CC BY 4.0; the model cards state cc-by-nc-4.0, and for weights the card governs. Claims large gains over YourMT3+ (onset F1 60.4 vs 32.5) on its own 372-track test set — unverified here by policy, since a paper metric is not evidence. Re-check only if the weights are relicensed.
